VB-G RAM G Scheme Notified Across States, Replacing MGNREGA

Several Indian states and Union Territories, including Karnataka and Punjab, have notified the implementation of the VB-G RAM G scheme, set to replace the MGNREGA from July 1. While some states are proceeding with the rollout, others, like Karnataka, are exploring legal options and seeking resolution of existing issues before the transition. Punjab's decision to notify the scheme comes after earlier opposition and a special assembly session that passed a resolution against it.
